clusters.name: Hazel's Parkinson's diagnosis, 1986–1997

clusters.name: Callum's move north, 1999–2000
clusters.reason: Callum argued with Duncan most nights over his plans to go north in January 1999; Odette could not settle at the thought of him so far away; he left home for a job at the mines in May. Duncan missed days at work and sat up late in the garage; Ines skipped school most of that autumn; Odette took Ines with her everywhere, even to work. Ines passed her exams and returned to school full days in August 2000, marking where the period settles.
